notes.subject: תלואים
notes.rationale: KJV 'are bent to backsliding' vs YLT 'are hanging in suspense' vs JPS 'in suspense about returning' — root תלא means to hang/be uncertain.

notes.subject: ירומם
notes.rationale: 'none at all would exalt him' (KJV) vs 'he will by no means exalt them' (BSB) — subject of the verb is disputed.

notes.subject: למשובתי
notes.rationale: Root שוב (turn/return) echoes through Hosea; 'tanim bel' (turn the belly) keeps the turning picture in Tok Pisin.

translation: Na ol manmeri bilong mi, ol i save tanim bel long pasin bilong lus long mi; na sapos ol i singautim i go long ⟨em⟩ we i stap antap, olgeta wantaim ol i no ken salim ⟨em⟩ antap.

tokens.gloss: long pasin bilong lus long mi
